featured_reviews.review_text: Visiting Mumbai for dental treatments and needed icecream to bring down swelling. Consulted AI and was recommended this place for vegan icecream.  None of the flavors labeled food allergens but when I asked they indicated the chocolate was vegan. Within minutes of eating I had severe bloating and nearly passed out on the street with ongoing distress that night and through surgery the next day. Not sure if the reaction was the milk products or water used. BEWARE!!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Rachel,
We’re truly sorry to hear about your experience and hope you’re feeling much better now. Your well-being is incredibly important to us, and this is very concerning to read.

We’d like to gently clarify for anyone reading that while we do offer a vegan option, we are not a vegan-only gelateria. Majority of our menu contains dairy, and we always encourage guests with allergies, sensitivities, or medical concerns to speak with our team in detail so we can guide them safely through the options. Additionally, our vegan flavours are made in the same facility as our dairy products, so we always like to highlight the possibility of cross-contact for those with very strict dietary restrictions.

Over the past six years of operating as a small-batch gelateria, we have not encountered a situation like this, which makes your experience especially concerning for us and something we would genuinely like to understand better.

We understand you discovered us through an AI recommendation; however, such sources may not always reflect our menu or ingredients accurately. For anything health-related, we always recommend checking directly with us.

That said, we would really appreciate the opportunity to speak with you, understand this in more detail, and make things right. Please feel free to reach out to us directly at 8291599737.

featured_reviews.name: Shamit Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pros
1. Low Sugar content
2. Strawberry and Classic are fantastic base options
3. Wide variety of toppings
4. Deceptively filling (A large could take 30 minutes to finish casually)
5. 6th day of every month carries a one on one free offer that's a no brainer grab
Cons
1. Base options are limited otherwise. No pineapple, coffee, chocolate, saffron, pistachio, Greek etc.
2. Servings cannot be customised. Most yogurt joints have a self-serve option that charges you only based on the weight, irrespective of the toppings or mixture of yogurt types.
3. Toppings are variegated but sorted differently with respect to the price. Basic toppings like chocolate fudge sauce, Nutella, compotes are placed in the premium category.

Yogurt has become a jargon for the person who really is seeking a tasty and healthy option. Its insanely difficult to find a good yogurt joint because they sprout with marketing gimmicks and delectable flavours that are artificially concocted calorie bombs.
I hadn't outright decided to try 6th street yogurt. My friend persuaded me to join him on the 6th because he had heard about it from a mutual friend. It's easy to spot from the main road as it is just round the corner of a lane at the foot of Kemps Corner.
There are 4 offerings of Yogurt flavours. Classic with a tinge of vanilla, Strawberry, Cranberry Melon and Blueberry. On inquiring with the employee I was told that all the flavours were 100% natural. They let you taste each to make a more decisive pick. I stuck my guns with the original and mounted it with dark chocolate and walnut fudge sauce for a healthy calorie intake. To my surprise, it was actually under-sweet.
Toppings are gamut. You got Oreo, chocolate chips and other chocolate based sauces, Compotes, fresh cut fruits, dried fruits and for the more colourful- red velvet, sprinkles, M&M and many more.
The joint is small, so it's best to take the cup and amble on the pavement while taking small bites or visiting at an uncommon hour if you're interested to stay put and eat.
Coming to the big question - can this yogurt topple your other dessert options?
Well, on some days, definitely. On a normal day, you would be spending roughly 200 on the yogurt (I recommend taking at least a size up from the smallest with one or two toppings.) It can replace your midday meal with a hearty and cold delight.

featured_reviews.name: saumil shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Apsara icecream is a renowned icecream parlour  brand of Mumbai since around 50 yrs. I believe as of today they have about 30 outlets in Mumbai itself.They also have outlets spread across other cities of India.I visited their Malabar hill outlet  yesterday night which is their iconic outlet

They serve variety of icecreams in cups(small,medium.large)  as well as cones.

Icecreams made here are with natural flavours and not artificial flavours.These icecreams are handchurned icecreams.

Staff service is reasonably good at Malabar hill outlet but i personally have seen better staff service at other parlours.Definite scope of improvement on staff service front.Apart from icecreams they also have sorbets & shakes.

Coming to variety of icecreams i tried here

Guava glory (small cup)- Star icecream of Apsara for me .Try it with red chilli powder(peru chaat masala) on top of icecream .Highly recommended

Malai kulfi stick -This about taking you back to sweet childhood memories.

Its a delicious sweet dessert served on stick .You will relish it if you like malai flavour.They also have options in pistachio and kesar pista.

Beligan bites (cone) -This i tried in waffle cone.This is all about enjoying Beligan chocolate with chips

Scrumptious sitafal(small cup) -A perfect combination of icecream and exotic creamy fruit.This is dessert goodness at next level.I personally loved it

Pan pasand(cone) - Before visiting this place.I had heard a lot of good things about their pan pasand icecream.Try this and you will thank me for recommending it

Tamarind twist(sorbet) - Imli in form of dessert.This is innovation and experimentation at its best.This sorbet has sharp flavour of tangy tamarind.

My overall experience was reasonably good at Apsara icecreams.A good option for late night icecream cravings.

I genuinely hope to see them coming up with premium range of desserts in coming times.

I didnt try their Thandai and couple of other shakes.Will definitely try it the next time i visit them

Overall - Definitely worth your  money

Check it out

Saumil shah

featured_reviews.name: Pankaj
featured_reviews.review_text: If there is any place that has stood the test of time, it is this. Known as Chowpatty kulfi, this small little shop remains just as popular over the past 6 decades. No frills and no seats, so stand and gobble down your plates of kulfi or have them packed up to be enjoyed at home.  They have a variety of flavours, but the classic ones are malai, pista, and kesar pista. As a child, I remember the thick slices wrapped in dry leaves, and the creamy goodness had me begging for more. Prices sure are steep, but that's should be expected. For those new to Mumbai, or have never been here, head down for a real Mumbai experience. They even have sugar-free varieties, which I tried and also accept digital payments.
